title: An asteroid called Leilani, found by Todd Fisher in old telescope images, remembers a neighbourhood lost to lava

posts.facebook:
No telescope, no astronomy degree: Todd Fisher found a new asteroid in archive images and named it for his sister's lost home.

How a citizen scientist with no training in astronomy found a new asteroid in eight-year-old telescope images, why he named it after Leilani Estates, and how to join the same search from a laptop.

Some of the most useful science left to do needs patient eyes more than expensive kit, and anyone with a computer can lend theirs.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/explore/todd-fisher-asteroid-leilani/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
